# Tree Hues Bharat Pvt. Ltd.

> Premier Interior Design, Turnkey Architecture & Dolby Atmos Home Theatre Studio in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

## Core Identity & Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Tree Hues Bharat Pvt. Ltd.
- **Founder & CEO**: Sachin Shetty
- **Headquarters**: A-403, Ravoos Rainbow, Hagadur, Whitefield, Bangalore, Karnataka, 560067, India
- **Phone**: +91 96862 11977
- **Email**: treehuesstudio@gmail.com / connect@tree-hues.com
- **Website**: https://www.tree-hues.com/

## Key Services
1. **Turnkey Luxury Residential Interiors**: Full-scope bespoke interior architecture for luxury duplex villas, penthouses, and premium apartments.
2. **Progressive Architecture & Civil Execution**: Structural planning, turnkey villa construction, layout alterations, and exterior facade design.
3. **Precision Timber Joinery & Modular Systems**: In-house factory-finished modular kitchens, bespoke wardrobe systems, and custom architectural woodwork.
4. **Dolby Atmos Private Cinema & Acoustic Engineering**: Acoustically isolated home screening rooms, 9.4.4 / 7.2.4 Dolby Atmos calibration, and custom acoustic fluted timber paneling.

## Landmark Projects Portfolio
- **Vajram Essenza / Tiara**: 4,800 Sq.Ft Modern Contemporary Luxury Villa, Bangalore.
- **Windmills of Your Mind (Villa 64)**: 5,200 Sq.Ft Earth-Modern Duplex Villa with solid teak joinery and internal courtyard.
- **Total Environment After The Rain**: 850 Sq.Ft Private 9.4.4 Dolby Atmos Cinema Sanctuary.
- **Araku Coffee Flagship Store**: 4,200 Sq.Ft Commercial Hospitality Flagship in Ashok Nagar, Bangalore.
- **V2 Poorvi Enclave**: 3,850 Sq.Ft Contemporary Luxury Residence on Sarjapur Road, Bangalore.
- **Mirabilis Residence**: 3,600 Sq.Ft Warm Minimalist Residence with fluted walls and bespoke millwork.
